QuestInfo.name: The Lost Permit 3
QuestInfo.0: 10 Boogies looks unhappy again. She's staring at her feet.
QuestInfo.1: So the Tigurus took the Ereve Investigation Permit! Defeat the Tigurus in Tiguru's Forest and recover the precious permit.
QuestInfo.2: You found the Ereve Investigation Permit! 10 Boogies will be overjoyed.

0.0: I just know I left it here, but... but... I lost the Ereve Investigation Permit. Do you think a Tiguru took it? They love permits... I think.

yes.0: As your new boss, I order you to beat up every Tiguru you see until I get that Ereve Investigation Permit back.

no.0: I thought you were my new assistant. Why are you not doing everything I say.

1.0: I knew it. Never trust a Tiguru with your paperwork.

yes.0: I'd better get this back to the big-guy before I lose it again.

item.0: Go defeat the Tigurus and bring me back that Ereve Investigation Permit.
